text: And in many respects it did. But ever since then, it has proven that America's been incapable of actually stopping Iran controlling the Strada Formuz. And even if America was to return to a military campaign, it looks very unlikely that there would be any difference to the military campaign that was before. And the bad side is that Iran has learnt from that experience. It has been targeting Saudi Arabia and targeting US military facilities in the Middle East. That has caused a great deal of difficulty for America's allies in the region, and also means that things like patriot missile systems are vital to protect against those ballistic missiles are now running in really short supply.
